title: [SUBEPIC][TOOLS-M12] Qualification and open release
body:
## Status as of 2026-09-19

Status as of 2026-09-19
- Dependencies: M8 (#5118) and M10 (#5121) merged; M11 (#4719) partial.
- Nothing delivered against this issue yet: recorded-rig fixtures, camera-count matrix, disconnect/determinism/perf budgets, packaging and release evidence all open.
- Coordinate with UpstreamDrift #9069 for rig recordings rather than duplicating capture tooling.

---

Parent epic: [MOCAP-TOOLS](https://github.com/D-sorganization/Tools/issues/4706)

## Outcome

Qualification and open release

## Scope

Known rigs, recorded fixtures, property/perturbation tests, camera-count matrix, disconnects, determinism, performance/storage budgets, documentation, packaging, and handoff.

## Authority and boundary

- Owning repository: `D-sorganization/Tools`
- Parent authority: MIT vendor-neutral data contracts, reference algorithms, backend protocols, session interchange, and C3D read/write/round-trip compatibility.
- Handoff: `AGENT_HANDOFF.md`
- Do not duplicate contracts owned by another repository. Integrate through versioned public seams.
- Unknown, unsupported, unapproved, private, or unavailable states must remain explicit and fail closed where authority is required.

## Dependencies

- [TOOLS-M8](https://github.com/D-sorganization/Tools/issues/4726)
- [TOOLS-M10](https://github.com/D-sorganization/Tools/issues/4727)
- [TOOLS-M11](https://github.com/D-sorganization/Tools/issues/4719)

## Acceptance

- Exact-HEAD export, protected checks, release artifacts, compatibility matrix, and post-merge verification pass.
- Public APIs and schemas are versioned, deterministic, documented, and exercised through consumer-facing contract tests.
- Error paths, missing data, limits, cancellation/recovery where relevant, provenance, and compatibility are tested.
- Repository SPEC/rules, calculation/manual traceability, user help, and `AGENT_HANDOFF.md` are updated with implementation.

## TDD and evidence contract

1. Capture the existing behavior and intended contract with a failing test before implementation.
2. Implement with DbC, DRY ownership, Law of Demeter boundaries, typed failures, and bounded resources.
3. Run focused tests and lint/type/format gates, then the repository's full required local gate.
4. Re-run from an exact-HEAD clean export/worktree to prove portability.
5. Open a full non-draft PR and verify exact head SHA, protected checks, reviews, merge SHA, and post-merge behavior/artifacts.
6. Record current limitations, blockers, test evidence, issue/PR links, and next dependency in the handoff.

## Closing policy

Feature work closes only through a merged implementation PR using a closing keyword, or a narrowly reviewed exemption that supplies equivalent evidence. Planning text or local green tests alone do not close this issue.
